about: What it costs to get into a curated spot, only where a dated source says so. A spot not listed here has entry { free: null }, and the app says "Entry: check at the gate". Never write free: true without a source that says free. See docs/LOCAL-FACTS.md, "Entry fees".

fees.note: About ₦1,000 to ₦2,000 at the gate; lounges and cabanas cost more

source.says: Entrance is relatively affordable, typically around N1,000–N2,000 at the gate, while access to premium lounges, cabanas, and private sections ranges widely from about N2,000 to over N150,000

fees.note: ₦1,000 per person at the gate since 2024 (Lagos parks agency)

source.says: In 2024, the Lagos State Parks and Gardens Agency (LASPARK) introduced a N1,000 access fee for individuals at public parks, including JJT Park.

fees.note: A paid resort: packages, not a free beach

source.says: La Campagne Tropicana Beach Resort Cost: N1.9 million ... The resort offers a range of exclusive getaway packages.
